The clinic

A neighbourhood clinic in the heart of Messines

Arca de Noé Veterinary Centre looks after companion animals and their families in São Bartolomeu de Messines, in the municipality of Silves.

Consultations, diagnostic tests, surgery, hospitalisation and grooming are all under one roof, so every visit is simple and well supported.

About the clinic

Appointments

Requesting an appointment is simple

  1. Choose the reason

    Preventive care, tests, surgery, grooming or something else.

  2. Call or send a request

    Phone the clinic during opening hours, or use the request form.

  3. Wait for confirmation

    The clinic confirms the day and time. The date you suggest is only a preference and is not booked automatically.

FAQ

Before your visit

Do I need an appointment?

Yes. Consultations are by appointment. You can call the clinic during opening hours or send an appointment request; the clinic will contact you to confirm the day and time.

Where is the clinic?

Rua Senhora Saúde, Lote 2, r/c D, 8375-138 São Bartolomeu de Messines, in the municipality of Silves. The contact page has a button to get directions.

What are the opening hours?

Monday to Friday, 10:00–13:30 and 16:30–19:30. Saturday, 10:00–13:30. Closed on Sundays. On public holidays, please call to check the opening hours.

Which services are available?

Check-ups, vaccinations, parasite control, lab tests, X-ray, ultrasound, electrocardiography, surgery, hospitalisation, baths and grooming. If you are unsure which service you need, ask the clinic.

What should I do in an urgent situation?

Call the clinic to check whether care is available. Please do not use the appointment request form for urgent situations, as requests are not read in real time.
